rows.label: Geometry Dash
rows.description: 2013 music-based platform video game and video game series
rows.hook: has you tap to make a cube jump over spikes in time with a pounding electronic soundtrack

rows.label: Outer Wilds
rows.description: 2019 video game developed by Mobius Digital
rows.hook: sends a space explorer through a solar system stuck in a 22-minute time loop before its sun explodes

rows.label: Among Us
rows.hook: has a crew on a spaceship trying to work out which of them is a secret saboteur

rows.label: Hollow Knight
rows.hook: follows a tiny armored bug exploring a ruined underground insect kingdom

rows.label: Flappy Bird
rows.description: 2013 mobile video game by Dong Nguyen
rows.hook: had players tapping to keep a small flyer between green pipes until it was pulled from app stores

rows.label: Hades
rows.description: 2020 action role-playing game developed by Supergiant Games
rows.hook: follows the son of the king of the underworld as he fights his way out again and again

rows.label: Balatro
rows.hook: turns poker hands into a roguelike deckbuilder where wild joker cards multiply your score

rows.label: Celeste
rows.hook: follows a young woman with red hair climbing a treacherous mountain while battling her own self-doubt

rows.label: Five Nights at Freddy's
rows.hook: has a night guard watching security cameras as animatronic animal mascots creep closer

rows.label: Cuphead
rows.hook: is a run-and-gun platformer with hand-drawn visuals inspired by 1930s rubber-hose cartoons

rows.label: Stray
rows.description: 2022 adventure video game developed by BlueTwelve Studio
rows.hook: lets you play as an orange cat exploring a neon-lit ruined city full of robots

rows.label: Slay the Spire
rows.hook: combines card battles with roguelike runs as you climb a tower picking cards and relics

rows.label: Subnautica
rows.description: 2018 survival action-adventure video game developed by Unknown Worlds Entertainment
rows.hook: strands you on an alien ocean planet where you gather resources and dive to ever deeper depths

rows.label: Ori and the Blind Forest
rows.hook: follows a small white guardian spirit through a dying woodland in a gorgeous platform adventure

rows.label: Cult of the Lamb
rows.hook: has you play a rescued sacrificial animal who founds a following and builds a village of woodland worshippers

rows.label: Untitled Goose Game
rows.hook: lets you play a mischievous waterfowl who honks and steals things to annoy villagers
